description: Storymap alluvione Valtellina 1987 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by protezionecivile.servizirl.it. In July 1987 Valtellina and the surrounding areas were the scene of an alluvial event among the most dramatic that the history of this area remembers. The final budget was 53 deaths and over EUR 1 billion in damage. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Valtellina Flood Storymap 1987" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include alluvione valtellina 1987. The listing shows 2018-12-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
